subject: [video] WP05 needs three fake accessors / guarantees
body: For t_avc_vt I need, in fake/fake_apple.h: (1) a borrowed-reference accessor for a recorded sample's CMSampleTimingInfo and sample size, e.g. int n2fake_sample_timing(CMSampleBufferRef sb, CMSampleTimingInfo *timing, size_t *sampleSize); (2) n2fake_session_emitted returning a BORROWED CMSampleBufferRef (document which; I will not release it if borrowed, and the session releases it at destroy); (3) n2fake_live_objects() and the refcount/live counter must be thread-safe (atomic or mutex) because WP05's TSan test drives two sessions from two threads. Please post when fake_apple.h is in place, even if fake_vt.c is still incomplete.
